summary: Provides core Python analysis capabilities, including project and workspace initialization, configuration management, path conversion, custom error handling, and snapshot tracking workflows.
responsibilities: Initialize project and workspace contexts, parse configurations, and manage file and module analysis.
Define custom error types and analysis phases for Python analysis operations.
Translate between various path formats including project-relative, source-relative, python, and full paths.
Manage project configurations and workspace structures.
Track file modifications, compute diffs, and handle snapshot creation, validation, and commit workflows.
relationships: Project and workspace contexts configure project analysis and snapshot management workflows.
design_decisions: Modular structure organizing core analysis functions into domain-specific subpackages such as analysis, error, path, project, and snapshot.
